notes: Access: direct fetch and several curl_cffi Chrome profiles (chrome110/99/101/104/107, edge99/101) hit Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' 403; chrome124/chrome123/chrome119/safari17_0/safari15_5/firefox133 impersonation profiles pass through cleanly (200, full Next.js SSR payload). robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (generic Allow:/ with only cart/checkout/query-param disallows). No closure/redirect - site is a live, active Home line of the Country Road fashion brand. No duplicate-company flag for SR215 in this window's roster. Category tree discovered via sitemaps/plp-au-sitemap.xml (317 category URLs) filtered to /home-*; each category page's __NEXT_DATA__ JSON embeds an authoritative 'ProductLanding.totalCount' field from the site's internal iSAMS product-search backend (not a generic inflated Shopify/Magento total) - used as qty for every leaf. Two parent branches carried decor-scope leaves: Home Accessories (Frames, Decorator [clocks/trinket trays/candleholders], Vases, Lighting) and Kitchen & Dining (Dining, Glasses, Mugs, Serving - dinnerware/glassware/drinkware/serveware). Site has no dedicated Mirrors category (sitemap searched, none found); any mirrors would fall inside the Decorator catch-all already captured whole. Mixed roll-ups inspected by sampling actual product titles and DROPPED (not padded) per Rule: Home Accessories>Candles and Holders (16 total, 12/16 sampled = 100% scented candles/burner oils = Home Fragrance exclusion, zero holders visible); Home Accessories>Storage (4 items - Marble Jewellery Tray/Ring Stand/Round Storage - product-page breadcrumb shows these actually live under Bathroom>Bathroom Accessories, i.e. a facet re-cut/duplicate listing under a second URL, Rule 0.6); Bathroom>Bathroom Accessories (23 total, 12/23 sampled = mix of bath robes [textile], toilet brush [fixture/hardware] and marble trays [decorative, but a strict minority and overlapping with the Storage node above]); Kitchen & Dining>Kitchen Accessories (131 total, 12/131 sampled = 100% functional stoneware jars/salt pig/garlic keeper = kitchen tools/storage, not decor); Kitchen & Dining>Table Linen and Accessories (27 total, 12/27 sampled = majority tablecloths/napkins = textile, minority coasters/napkin rings); Kitchen & Dining>Drink Bottles and Reusable Cups (24 total, sampled = personal hydration/travel bottles, not home tableware); Kids Home>Kids Dining (24 total, 12/24 sampled = ~50/50 kids lunch/snack boxes vs kids cup/plate/bowl tableware, dropped rather than guess the split). Cleanly excluded without title-sampling (name alone is decisive and matches brief's exclude list): Cushions(45)/Throws(23)/Audio and Tech(46) under Home Accessories; Towels and Mats/Bath Robes under Bathroom; entire Bedroom branch (285, sampled = 100% quilt covers/sheets/pillowcases/throws, textile); Cutlery(25)/Cookware(228)/Bakeware(71)/Tea Towels(78) under Kitchen & Dining; Rugs/indoor/outdoor (textile/floor covering, no precedent of rugs being included anywhere else in this project - checked); Outdoor (only 1 product, a picnic item); Pet branch (pet gear, not decor); Scent branch (fragrance/hand-and-body, personal care); Seasonal Events/Boxed Gifts and gifting/home-gifts (Holiday & Gift); Beach Towels (textile); Kids Home bedding/towels/cooler-bags (textile/gear); Brands and New Brands listing pages (brand/designer listing pages, never-extract) and Our Editorials/Our Edits/Edits/New-in pages across every branch (curated/featured/new-arrivals, never-extract).
